steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with the two stated bids.
Enable automatic event scheduling required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects required by the case.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the event's stage settings.
Verify the dialog contains the expected recreate options.
Verify auction configuration is offered in the dialog.
Enable scheduling for the recreated event.
Select tomorrow in the open scheduling date picker; the exact date-field label is not specified.
Set the scheduled start time requested by the case.
Create the recreated event with the selected schedule.
Verify the resulting event displays the requested start time.
Verify the recreated event is upcoming and offers Reschedule Event.
